library_db.label: beets library database
library_db.description: Path to beets' library.db as seen by Music Assistant, for example /media/beets/library.db. Music Assistant only reads it.

music_directory.label: Music directory
music_directory.description: Where beets' music directory is mounted, as seen by Music Assistant.

beets_directory.label: beets music directory on its own host
beets_directory.description: Optional. The directory value from your beets config, for example /home/you/Music. Files beets stored with this full path are looked up in the music directory instead.

manifest.description: Play the music library you manage with beets.

user.title: Set up beets
user.description: Point Music Assistant at your beets library database and music directory. Music Assistant never changes your beets library.

errors.library_db_not_found: The beets library database file does not exist.
errors.library_db_invalid: This file is not a readable beets library database.
errors.music_directory_not_found: The music directory does not exist.
